:::{#exr-argmax-positive-multiple}
#### Scaling a function by a positive number

Let $g(x) = x(4 - x)$ for $x \in [0, 4]$.

1. Rewrite $g(x)$ using the [square](algebra.qmd#def-square) $(x - 2)^2$.
   Use it to find the [argmax](#def-argmax) of $g$ over $[0, 4]$.
2. Let $f(x) = 5\,g(x)$ on $[0, 4]$.
   Find the argmax of $f$ over $[0, 4]$.
   Is it the same [set](sets.qmd#def-set) as the argmax of $g$?
   Is the largest [value](functions.qmd#def-value) of $f$ the same as the largest value of $g$?

:::
